newsitem.title: USA: Campbell to introduce new pasta sauce line.
newsitem.headline: Campbell to introduce new pasta sauce line.

text.p: Campbell Soup Co said Tuesday it will introduce a line of "super-premium" pasta sauces beginning next month.
The new line, "Prego Primor," will compete in the super-premium pasta sauce segment, Campbell said.
The company will continue to sell its regular Prego spaghetti sauce line, known for the "It's In There," it said.
It said Prego Primor pasta sauces will be available in 26-ounce glass jars in four varieties--traditional herb and garlic; mushroom; four cheese; and roasted garlic and onion.
It said the new products will be available in supermarkets nationally beginning next month at a suggested retail price of $2.69.
